chunks: Muḥammad ibn ‘Abdillāh ibn Ja’far Al-Ḥimyari narrated to me from his father, from Ya’qūb ibn Yazīd, from Muḥammad ibn Abī ‘Umayr, from Zayd Al-Shaḥḥām, from Abū ‘Abdillāh (peace be upon him) who said:
Whoever visits the grave of Al-Ḥusayn (peace be upon him) on the fifteenth of Sha'bān, Allāh will forgive him for what preceded of his sin and what followed.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting the grave of Imam Husain on the 15th of Sha'ban?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, the fifteenth of Sha'bān (Laylat al-Bara'ah) is a pivotal night of divine decree and forgiveness, making this specific Ziyārah a unique opportunity to merge the intercession of Imam Al-Ḥusayn with the general mercy of Allah. This hadith from Kamil al-Ziyarat underscores the profound spiritual efficacy of visiting the grave of the grandson of the Prophet during this auspicious time, promising comprehensive absolution of sins. It reflects the Shia emphasis on the interconnectedness of the Ahl al-Bayt's status and the believer's path to divine pardon.
